name: House Shifting
short: Complete home relocation — local or intercity — with packed, inventoried, insured transit.
description: Our core service: a trained crew packs your home room by room under a supervisor, loads against a shared inventory list, transports on the right-sized vehicle, and places boxes in the right rooms at the new address. Every move gets a written, itemised quote before you commit — no booking advance, no verbal pricing.

features.title: Pre-move survey
features.text: A short video or in-person survey sizes the inventory, floor access and vehicle approach — this is what makes the written quote a promise instead of a guess.

features.title: Room-wise packing & labelling
features.text: Kitchen, wardrobe, electronics and fragiles each get their own packing spec and labels, so unloading is placement, not a scavenger hunt.

features.title: Furniture dismantling & reassembly
features.text: Beds, wardrobes and modular units are dismantled, hardware bagged and labelled, and reassembled at the new home as part of the standard scope.

features.title: Written quote, no advance
features.text: The itemised quote comes first and payment follows its terms. If scope changes on move day, the change is discussed and priced before it happens.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book house shifting?
faqs.a: A week is comfortable in most cities; peak season (March–July) and month-ends need more, mainly because society lift slots and gate passes have their own lead times. Same-week moves are often possible — WhatsApp us your date and we'll say honestly what's feasible.

faqs.q: Is dismantling and reassembly of beds and wardrobes included?
faqs.a: Yes — standard furniture dismantling and reassembly is part of the quoted scope, with hardware bagged and labelled per item. Custom or wall-anchored carpentry is flagged in the survey and quoted separately if needed.

faqs.q: How are kitchen and fragile items packed?
faqs.a: Crockery and glassware move in double-walled cartons with paper/foam separation; appliances are padded and stretch-wrapped. Fragile cartons are marked and loaded top-tier, never under furniture weight.

faqs.q: What if something is damaged in the move?
faqs.a: Report it to your move supervisor or on WhatsApp with photos — the claims process is written and linked from our terms. Transit insurance on declared value is explained in your quote, including what is and isn't covered.
